title: Swift Package List Plugin Configuration v2
description: Configuration for SwiftPackageListPlugin. Relative paths are resolved against the project directory.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema used by editors to validate this configuration.

version.description: The configuration format version. Must be 2.

projectPath.description: Path to the project or workspace. Defaults to Package.swift for Swift packages or the current .xcodeproj for Xcode projects.

targets.description: Options keyed by target name (displayName in Xcode). The '*' entry applies to targets without an explicit entry. Explicit entries do not inherit options from '*'; omitted or null options use the plugin defaults.

environments.description: Options keyed by environment name. Select an entry by setting SWIFT_PACKAGE_LIST_PLUGIN_ENVIRONMENT to its exact name.

outputType.description: Output format. stdout prints to the build log; other formats generate a file in the plugin work directory.

packageOrder.description: The order of packages in the generated output.

requiresLicense.description: Include only packages with a license.

ignorePackages.description: Package identity patterns to exclude from the output. Glob patterns are supported.

customPackagesFilePaths.description: Paths to custom package files to include in the output.

customSourcePackagesPath.description: Path to the SourcePackages directory. When omitted or null, the plugin searches for SourcePackages in the plugin work directory and its ancestors.
